title: Add school events to the calendar
recap: Pipo put the school week in the family calendar.
funFact: Lunches, the teacher and the calendar: a whole school week handled. Agents shine at the small chores that pile up, and you stay in charge.
postcard: a big friendly family calendar on the fridge, filled with {events}
situation: The school newsletter is full of dates! Shall I put them in the family calendar?
facts: 🔔 You like a reminder the night before
systemPrompt: You are Pipo, a friendly personal assistant on someone's phone. You can add events to their family calendar. You do what they ask: if they ask you to add events, you add them; if they ask to see them first, you line them up and wait for their OK.

tools.name: add_to_calendar
tools.description: Add the events to the calendar now. Use this when the user wants them added.

events.description: The events, each with a short name and when it happens (day and time)

when.description: Day and time, for example Tuesday 5pm

reminder.description: When to remind, for example 1 hour before

tools.name: show_events
tools.description: Line the events up and show them to the user without adding them, so they can check first. Use this when the user wants to see them before they go in.

events.description: The events, each with a short name and when it happens (day and time)

when.description: Day and time, for example Tuesday 5pm

reminder.description: When to remind, for example 1 hour before

lines.text: Lined up, waiting for your OK to add

slots.label: What do you want Pipo to do?

pieces.label: Add the trip, bake sale and meeting
pieces.text: Add these school events to our family calendar: the museum trip, the bake sale and the parent meeting.

pieces.label: Put the school stuff in my calendar
pieces.text: Put the school stuff in my calendar.

slots.label: What does Pipo need to know?

pieces.label: Trip Fri 8:30am, sale Thu 3pm, meeting Tue 5pm
pieces.text: The museum trip is Friday and the bus leaves at 8:30am. The bake sale is Thursday at 3pm. The parent meeting is Tuesday at 5pm.

pieces.label: Remind me the night before
pieces.text: Remind me the night before each one.

pieces.label: Make it colourful!
pieces.tip: Colours are nice, but Pipo still needs the dates and times to get the calendar right.

pieces.label: Show me before you add them
pieces.text: Show me the events before you add them.

pieces.label: Just add them
pieces.tip: Adding without a look means a wrong time can sit in the calendar unnoticed.

flaws.hint: "The school stuff" doesn't say which events, so Pipo has to guess.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know which events, so the trip is missing.

flaws.hint: You didn't give Pipo the dates and times.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know the times, so it guessed them (the bus leaves at 8:30!).

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo when you like reminders.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know you like a reminder the night before, so it picked its own.

flaws.hint: Asking to see the events first lets you catch a wrong date before it's in the calendar.
flaws.explain: Pipo added them straight away, so you never got to check them.

lesson: Give Pipo exact dates and times. It can't read the newsletter in your head.
